name: Merge tractmasks into individual mask
summary: Utility that concatenates the individual tract masks of a tractmasks dataset into one 4D mask image with FSL fslmerge, keeping the label file.
description: Reads the tract names from color.json and stacks the masks in that order into masks/mask.nii.gz (one volume per tract), copying color.json as label.json. Use it when a downstream App expects all tract masks in a single file. Needs a tractmasks dataset with a color.json listing its tracts.

inputs.description: Tract masks dataset: one NIfTI mask per tract plus color.json with tract names.
inputs.requirements: Masks must share the same grid; file names must start with the names in color.json.

outputs.description: Single 4D mask.nii.gz with one volume per tract, plus label.json.

failure_modes.fix: Check that mask file names match the names in color.json.
